messages:
cass: Heads up — found a bundler-specific breakage when trying to run the JS SDK in our edge sample.

cass: Environment: vite 3 + rollup, sample-app set to \"type: \"module\"\". Build succeeds but running against miniflare produces: \n\nError: Super expression must either be null or a function
    at _inheritsLoose (sdk-compiled.js:45:12)
\n
cass: Minimal repro attached locally. Import is simple: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`.

lee: ugh. which published files do you have in node_modules/@redwood/inference? any `.mjs` vs `.cjs` split?

cass: package.exports looks like:
```json
{
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

jamie: that layout often trips up rollup-plugin-node-resolve depending on extension preference. Rollup can pick the CJS build then Babel/rollup converts it into an interop wrapper that isn't compatible with edge class inheritance.

riley: quick try: does `rollup-plugin-commonjs({ transformMixedEsModules: true })` change the failure? worked for a similar lib for me.

cass: tried that — it silenced the super expression error but then we hit `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'default')` in the same runtime.

lee: for vite you can also force the ESM entry with alias: `alias: { '@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.mjs' }`. That got the sample app running for me.

cass: alias helped. but this is an onboarding trap: our starter template doesn't include that and new devs hit it on first run.

jamie: SDK team checklist suggestion:
- add a `module` field or ensure `exports` has an unambiguous ESM entry resolvable by rollup/vite
- include `.mjs` ESM files and prefer them for bundlers
- expose `types` at top-level so `import type` works across TS configs
- add bundler matrix CI (vite, rollup, webpack) building the sample apps

riley: also test different import styles in the sample app: `import default`, `import * as`, and `const = require()` — bundlers handle them inconsistently.

cass: created RED-PLAT/SDK#1601 with a minimal repo link and stack traces (placeholder). tagging @eng-ml and @devexp.

deploy-bot: New issue created: RED-PLAT/SDK#1601 by cass — "Bundler-specific ESM/CJS mismatch breaks edge sample app (vite/rollup)"

lee: short-term action — add a line to sample-app README with the alias workaround + a recommended rollup plugin config, so new hires are unblocked.

cass: PR incoming for README + tiny vite/rollup snippet. I'll reference the SDK issue and include repro steps:
1) clone minimal repo
2) npm i
3) npm run build
4) npm run start:edge (miniflare/wrangler)

jamie: long-term, SDK should publish a small compatibility note and maybe a single-file UMD/ESM compat build for bundlers that do naive resolution. Also add tests that run `miniflare` on built artifacts in CI.

riley: fwiw I saw webpack v5 handle this layout fine in a previous project; adding webpack to the CI matrix helps catch regressions too.

cass: thanks all — will update with PR and issue links when ready.
